article.summary_es: Temple Shaaray Tefila es una despensa de alimentos o cocina comunitaria que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad, ubicado en 250 E 79th St, en Manhattan. Ofrece una cocina comunitaria los miércoles de 11:15am a 12pm.
article.summary_en: Temple Shaaray Tefila is a food pantry or soup kitchen on the City's Food Help NYC map, located at 250 E 79th St in Manhattan. It offers a soup kitchen on Wednesdays from 11:15am to 12pm.
